findings.detail: The new comment is honest about the 429 cost (rotateKey() returns false on one key, 4 attempts, 60s sleeps, ~3 minutes) but stops one step short of the consequence users actually experience. TranslateTab drives this in a batch loop and its catch does `setStatus(ERROR); return;` — bailing *before* the '--- 4. APPLY RESULTS TO ROWS ---' block. `translationMap` is handler-local, so every batch that already succeeded is thrown away with it. Pro's free-tier RPM is materially tighter than Flash's and the loop only spaces batches by 200ms, so a large sheet now plausibly translates 30 batches, spends three minutes retrying batch 31, and hands the user nothing. Before this change the same path existed but Flash's headroom made it rare; this diff is what moves it from theoretical to likely. Anchoring here because line 146 is the change that raises the probability — the loop itself is outside this diff. Raise to high if Translate is routinely run on sheets large enough to exceed Pro's per-minute quota on a single key, since then the bail-out is the common case rather than the tail.
findings.summary: Pro on translateBatch makes a whole-run bail-out that discards completed batches much more reachable

findings.detail: The PR's stated goal is that callers choose a tier rather than a model id so the provider stays swappable. That indirection is applied only to extractStructuredData. translateBatch (line 146), processGeneralFile (line 265) and extractFromMedia (line 294) still assign `GEMINI_PRO` directly, so three of the four paths remain expressed in Gemini's vocabulary inside the service. That is defensible — those three are internal to geminiService.ts, and the tier only needs to exist where a *caller outside the file* selects it — but it means MODEL_BY_TIER is currently a one-entry-point map rather than the file's model-selection mechanism, and the next person adding a call site has two conventions to choose between. No user impact; purely a consistency-of-intent note.
findings.summary: MODEL_BY_TIER is wired into one of four model call sites
